messages:
Maria Alvarez: Heads-up — access hygiene window opens Mon 3/18. Goal: close all staging admin exceptions older than 30d and collect evidence for any accepted exceptions. Please flag owners today. :spiral_calendar:
Cheng Li: I've got a blocker — found cross-account KMS grants from staging toanalytics-prod svcacct that didn't show owner metadata. Listing them now.
Cheng Li: Query I'm using:
```
aws iam list-grants --key-id alias/staging-kms --query 'Grants[?starts_with(GranteePrincipal, `arn:aws:iam::`)]'
```
Cheng Li: results: 8 grants, 3 to prod acct, 2 older than 45d.
Olivia Patel: Can you drop that list into the shared sheet? I'll start owner outreach for the 45d ones. link: https://redwood.app/sheets/admin-hygiene
Samir Khan: FYI — vuln triage flagged a high CVE on infra-deployer last week; if any admin roles tie to that svcacct we should expedite removal. :warning:
Maria Alvarez: good call. Cheng — mark any principals tied to infra-deployer as 'urgent' in the sheet.
Cheng Li: done. Also filing a short REMED ticket: https://redwood.app/tickets/SE-1122
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled — access-review kickoff on Mon 09:00 PDT. Owners without responses will be auto-notified at 72h. :bell:
Olivia Patel: For audit evidence, use this runbook snippet to bundle logs:
```
# gather kms keygrants + iam role history
./scripts/gather_evidence.sh --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-03-01 --keys staging-kms
```
Olivia Patel: If anyone needs help running it in prod, DM me.
Maria Alvarez: Plan: triage list today, owner outreach tomorrow, remediation targets by EOW. If removal is blocked, we'll require documented justification + expiry date in the sheet.
Samir Khan: I'll coordinate with sec-ops to patch infra-deployer and notify SOC to watch related alerts.
audit-bot: Evidence bundle created for SE-1122 by Olivia Patel at 1728245580.
Olivia Patel: quick note — a couple of entries are service-role bindings (not human admins). We should convert those to short-lived STS roles and rotate keys.
Cheng Li: Agree — adding rotate+sts action to ticket.
Maria Alvarez: Thanks team. Quick ask: add your slack handles in the sheet so we can ping faster. :thumbsup:
